# apple_subscription_price (Resource)

Sets a subscription's price in one territory, from a date. Each territory needs a price; a dated price schedules a change. Find price points with `data.apple_subscription_price_points`. Prices can't be changed, so changing any argument adds a new price. Destroying the resource deletes a price that hasn't started; a price in effect stays until another replaces it. Import it with `<subscription_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_subscription_price_points" "usd" {
  subscription_id = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  territories     = ["USA"]
  customer_prices = ["4.99"]
}

resource "apple_subscription_price" "usa" {
  subscription_id = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  price_point_id  = data.apple_subscription_price_points.usd.price_points[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `price_point_id` (String) ID of the price point, which sets the territory and price.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

### Optional

- `plan_type` (String) Plan the price is for: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly. Defaults to `UPFRONT`.
- `preserve_current_price` (Boolean) For a price increase, whether existing subscribers keep their current price. Defaults to `false`.
- `start_date` (String) First day of the price, e.g. `2026-12-01`. Unset means now.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the price.
- `territory` (String) Territory of the price, e.g. `USA`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_price.usa
  identity = {
    subscription_id = "6446452616"
    id              = "eyJzIjoiNjQ0NjQ1MjYxNiJ9"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the price.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_price.usa 6446452616/eyJzIjoiNjQ0NjQ1MjYxNiJ9
```
